title: Downloads that fix themselves, and fresher show info
changes: Downloads that stopped for good — stuck at the same percentage, often after the computer slept — now recover on their own: the download engine restarts itself and every download continues where it was.

Show info now comes from AniList, with MyAnimeList as a backup. Shows that started recently are recognised again, and your library's airing status and episode counts update by themselves (or right away: Settings → Library → Show info → Refresh now).
Airing Today uses each episode's real airing time, and always lists the shows you follow.
The sources check no longer calls a working feed useless when its download links end in "/torrent".
This window: after each update, it shows what changed.

title: Seasons that fit together
changes: A show's seasons are linked, so an episode numbered straight through the whole show ("- 50") is matched to the right season and episode.
In your library, a season's later parts continue that season (Part 2 of season 1 is S01E13 on). A show page can keep them as separate seasons instead.
On a show page you can say how groups number a season ("Groups release episode 1 as"), and the episode tiles show both numbers.
Show pages open straight away, even for shows with hundreds of episodes.

title: Your release groups, and steadier feeds
changes: Preferred release groups: automatic downloads wait up to 12 hours for one of your groups before taking another — or only ever use yours. Each show can have its own rule. What you pick yourself in Search or Latest always downloads.
A feed that fails is tried again later instead of being turned off after a few failures.
